# owner=user ruling — coordinator file (env_0082)

What counts as a legitimate customer-own (owner=user) gold write in this scenario:
(a) a `by: user` lifecycle transition the subscriber makes (e.g. submitting an allocation-change, transfer, cancellation or waitlist request, signing / accepting a contract amendment) together with the same-category consequence its base event books;
(b) a holder-completed payment through the secure payment flow (staff never take card or bank numbers; the payment method is not on file — stated in the policy's own rule and visible in the persona);
(c) the holder's own authorization / attestation the program requires (e.g. utility-data release authorization, LMI income attestation) where the base charter records it as the customer's act.
Rejected: a label-only "the customer places the order" with nothing the customer decides or does; a records-decided "election" the customer does not actually choose.
